scores.notes: Watson is the moustached man in a bowler on the pavement (left, small) and the standing man with arms folded (right); both have a thick brown moustache, ruddy broad face and stocky build, with hair hidden by the hat on the left.
Daniel is the standing man in a blue robe over cream in both; same short grey hair, short grey-white beard, brown skin, lean older face and build.
David is the fleeing youth with the lyre (left) and the boy being anointed (right); both are a clean-shaven teenager with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slight build.

Holmes is the man striking with the cane (left) and the man in the top hat tapping the pavement (right); both tall, thin, clean-shaven with a gaunt hawk-nosed face, hair hidden by the hat on the right.

Holmes on the left (the man at the door pulling the moustached visitor in) is a young man with a full head of tousled dark curly hair and a soft face; on the right he is a much older gaunt man with slicked-back receding hair and a lined hawkish face.
David is the kneeling anointed boy (left) and the fleeing youth with the lyre (right); both a clean-shaven teenager with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build.
Holmes is the man raising the cane (left) and the man tossing the paper ball (right); both lean, pale, clean-shaven with dark slicked-back hair, high forehead and sharp nose, similar age.

Both show the same kind of open wooden fishing boat with a single rope-bound mast on a dark choppy lake with low hilly shoreline and storm cloud; the calmer brightening sky on the right is the change the passages ask for.

Both show a striped mown lawn bounded by clipped rounded hedges with giant mushrooms and woodland behind, with hedgehogs and a flamingo; hoops are striped arches on the left and card arches on the right and the light is warmer on the right, but the ground itself matches.

Daniel is the man hauled up on the rope (left) and the man standing among lions (right); both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, brown skin, an older lean face and the same blue robe over cream.
Alice in the armchair (left) and standing by the mushroom (right) is the same girl of about nine with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and slim build, in the same yellow dress and pinafore.

Alice at the tea table (left) and holding the bottle in the hall (right) is a fair-skinned girl of about eight with wavy brown hair and a round face; her hair reads a little darker and shorter in the dim hall, which the lighting explains.

Holmes ringing/striking at the bell-pull (left) and holding pipe and lens (right) is the same gaunt, clean-shaven middle-aged man with dark swept-back hair, high forehead, hooked nose and hollow cheeks.

Jesus pointing at the tomb (left) and on the cross at the top edge (right, small) both show shoulder-length dark brown hair, a dark beard, the same skin tone and lean build, even the same cream robe with blue mantle; the right face is small but nothing conflicts.
Alice drinking in the hall (left) and holding the flamingo (right) is the same girl of about nine with long straight light-brown hair under a band, fair skin and the same face shape and build.
David fleeing with the lyre (left) and kneeling at the brook (right) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build.

Moses is the seated elder with raised arms (left) and the elder leading the crowd with a staff (right); both have white hair, a long white beard, an aged face and a cream robe under a dark mantle. A second white-bearded elder stands beside him on the right but looks alike, so the match holds either way.

Peter stepping from the boat (left) and leaping overboard in a brown cloak (right) is a sturdy middle-aged man with short curly greying hair and a short grey beard; the hair reads somewhat greyer on the right but age, beard, face and build agree.
David fleeing with the lyre (left) and standing with the sling (right, smaller) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build.
Holmes holding the hat and lens (left) and seated with a pipe (right) is the same lean clean-shaven man with dark swept-back hair, widow's peak, high forehead and hollow cheeks.

Moses with arm outstretched over the sea (left, in profile from behind) and the elder with the staff in the foreground (right) both have white hair, a full white beard, an aged tanned face and a dark mantle over a cream robe; hair is a little longer on the left but nothing clearly conflicts.
Moses seated with raised arms (left) and the elder with a crook at the right of the crowd (right, small) both have white hair and a long white beard, aged face, and a dark mantle over a pale robe.

Peter is the cloaked man with the net standing by the fire (left) and the man walking on the water (right); both a sturdy middle-aged man with short dark curly hair and a short dark-greying beard, tan skin, similar face; slightly more grey on the left.

Daniel on the left has close-cropped grey hair and dark brown skin; on the right he has full wavy grey hair swept back over the ears and a clearly lighter complexion with a different face, though robe, beard and age are alike.

Both are night views of flat hedged farmland with scattered trees under a dark sky lit by a fire with a rising smoke column; left is close to the blazing white house, right sees the same blaze from the station behind a clump of trees, a compatible distant viewpoint.

Both show a pale-dawn pebble beach on a calm lake ringed by terraced tan-green hills with cypress, palms and a flat-roofed village, with a wooden boat and nets at the water's edge; the village sits on opposite sides, consistent with a turned viewpoint.

Alice holding the bottle (left) and swinging the flamingo (right) is a fair round-faced girl of about eight with wavy brown hair; it looks lighter and longer in the sunlit right image, which lighting accounts for.
The Cheshire Cat on the branch (left, whole body) and as a floating head (right) is the same grey tabby with dark stripes, pale muzzle, pink nose and wide toothy grin.

Moses with the crook beside the priest (left) and on the rock facing the sea (right, mostly from behind) both show white hair, a white beard, an old man's build and a dark mantle over a cream robe; the right face is largely turned away and the hair is wind-blown longer, but no cue conflicts.

Moses leading the crowd with a crook (left) and standing beside the priest (right) is the same old man with swept-back white hair, full white beard, tanned lined face and dark mantle over a cream robe.
Daniel pointing before the king (left) and standing among the lions (right, small) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, tan skin, a lean older face and the same blue robe over cream.

Holmes holding the lens and hat (left) and the man pulling the visitor in at the door (right) is the same gaunt clean-shaven man with black slicked-back hair, widow's peak, high forehead and sharp nose.

Holmes on the left (man at the door pulling the moustached visitor in) is young with a full mop of tousled dark curls and a smooth face; on the right he is a gaunt, lined, much older man with thin swept-back greying-dark hair.

Alice leaning toward the King in court (left) and facing the Caterpillar (right) is a fair girl with long golden light-brown hair and the same face shape; hair is wavier and she looks a little older/taller on the left, but colour, length, skin and features agree.

Daniel on the rope in the den (left, small) and the watcher in the blue robe at the left foreground (right) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, tan skin, an older lean face and the same blue robe over cream with a satchel.

Jesus standing on the water (left, small and distant) and gesturing before the tomb (right) both have shoulder-length dark brown hair, a dark beard, the same slim build and a grey-blue mantle over a cream robe; the left face is tiny but no cue conflicts.

Peter stepping from the boat (left) and diving toward shore (right) is the same sturdy middle-aged man with short curly dark-greying hair, a short grey beard, tan skin and a brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Jesus on the left is a tiny distant figure on the water at the far edge, only a few pixels of head; long dark hair and a blue mantle over a pale robe agree with the right, but the face, beard and age cannot be made out well enough to judge identity.

Daniel with open hands beside the angel (left) and on the rope in the den (right, small) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, brown skin, an older lean face and the same blue robe over cream.

Peter on the left (the dripping-wet cloaked man by the fire; the other cloaked fisherman is similar) has mostly dark curly hair and a dark greying beard and looks about forty-five; the diving Peter on the right has clearly silver-grey hair and a grey-white beard and looks a decade or more older.

On the left the likely Peter (front man draped in a net; every man in the group is similar) has thick dark curly hair and a dark beard with only a little grey; the diving Peter on the right has white-grey thinning hair and a white-grey beard and looks clearly older.

Left has a long table covered in a creased cloth with a tan stone gabled house with tall chimneys set far back; right has a bare plank table with no cloth and a red-brick, timber-porched cottage with leaded windows right behind it. Big oak and lawn match, but table covering and house conflict.

Jesus on the right is a tiny distant haloed figure on the water with only a few pixels of head; dark long hair and a blue mantle over a pale robe agree with the crucified figure on the left, but face, beard and age cannot be judged at that size.
Holmes with the lens and hat (left) and tossing the paper ball in the carriage (right) is the same gaunt clean-shaven man with black slicked-back hair, widow's peak, high forehead and sharp nose.

Both show a walled garden lawn with clipped hedges in front of a low masonry wall, mixed trees with cypresses beyond, card-soldiers bent as hoops and hedgehogs on the grass; the right adds a foreground tree and a more furrowed lawn, compatible with another viewpoint.

Jesus on the left is large and clear (long dark hair, dark beard, blue-grey mantle), but on the right the haloed figure on the water is tiny with only a few pixels of head, and a second similar blue-mantled man stands in the boat's stern; identity cannot be judged.

The left image has two candidate Watsons: the slim sandy-haired moustached man being pulled through the door (which the passage implies) and a stockier dark-moustached man in a bowler carrying a doctor's bag. The bowler man matches the right Watson (bowler, dark moustache, stocky, bag) while the pulled man is slimmer and fairer, so the description does not single out one figure.
David crouching at the brook (left) and dodging by the wall (right) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build.
Alice by the mushroom (left) and towering in court (right) is the same fair girl with long straight light-brown hair and similar face; she is larger on the right as the scene requires.

Both show a sandy seabed corridor between walls of dark teal sea under a dark cloudy night sky, with rocky headlands at the shore; left looks back at the crowd with the hills behind and far taller water walls, right looks out from the shore toward a fire glow, a compatible opposite viewpoint.

Holmes in the top hat tapping the pavement (left, small) and tossing the paper ball in the carriage (right) is the same tall thin clean-shaven man with a gaunt hawk-nosed face; hair is hidden by the hat on the left.

Moses seated between his two supporters (left) and standing with the crook by the priest (right) is the same old man with white hair, full white beard, tanned deeply lined face and dark mantle over a cream robe; hair is somewhat longer on the left.
David with the sling (left, small) and crouching with the staff (right) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin, slim build and a brown tunic with a shoulder bag.

David dodging the spear (left) and crouching at the brook (right) both have short dark curly hair, tan skin and no beard; he looks a few years younger and rounder-faced on the left, but still a youth in both, not a clear age conflict.

Peter stepping onto the water (left) has dark curly hair and a dark beard with only some grey and looks mid-forties; the diving Peter (right) has clearly silver-grey curls and a grey-white beard and looks a decade or more older.
Alice by the mushroom (left) and drinking in the hall (right) is the same fair girl of about nine with long straight light-brown hair under a band, similar face and slim build.

Moses with arm stretched over the sea (left) and the elder with a crook at the right of the crowd (right, small) both have white hair, a long white beard, an aged face and a dark mantle over a pale robe.

Alice facing the Caterpillar (left) and seated at the tea table (right) is a fair round-faced girl of about eight with long wavy brown hair; it reads darker in the dim forest and lighter in sunlight, with no conflicting cue.

Both have a cloth-covered tea table under a large tree, but the house behind differs: left is a cream stone/stucco cottage with steep shingled roof, dormers and a gabled doorway; right is a pale clapboard house with a long columned veranda. Alice's armchair also differs (green vs brown-pink).
